title: Timing Share of Next-Period Coverage: Days to the Next Due Date (Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement)
content:
The next-period coverage collected with a good-standing payment on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement carries a timing share, counted in calendar days from the handling date to the next due date, the day after the last day of the latest billed period:

| Next due date, in calendar days after the handling date | Share of the coverage |
|---|---|
| more than 28 | 50 percent |
| 15 to 28 | 75 percent |
| fewer than 15 | the whole month |

The share multiplies the coverage before it is rounded to the cent, half up, once. The latest billed period is the latest rent charge on the agreement's ledger, with its last day.

## Edges (hypothetical latest billed period 15 March to 14 April, next due date 15 April)

| Handling date | Days to 15 April | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 17 March | 29 | 50% |
| 18 March | 28 | 75% |
| 31 March | 15 | 75% |
| 1 April | 14 | whole month |

## Worked figure
A covered month of $144.00 with the next due date 26 days away: 75 percent of $144.00 is $108.00.
